description: LanammeUCR, the national materials and structural models laboratory of the University of Costa Rica, which audits the country's road network by law, publishes its official maps on an ArcGIS hub. The hub read on 2026-09-28 offers interactive applications for bridges on national routes and on cantonal routes, the national and cantonal road networks, technical audits and site visits on the road network, the evaluation of slopes and hillsides along roads, weather stations and an assessment of bus stops. Coverage is Costa Rica. Access is free to view; the footer gives Universidad de Costa Rica copyright, and the hub's search service listed no downloadable items. Caveats: layers are viewable in maps and apps only, so attributes such as bridge condition ratings must be read inside each application. It supports exposure and resilience studies of the road network, such as combining bridge locations with slope instability along national routes. Related record: the MOPT national road network maps of Costa Rica.
name: LanammeUCR geoportal: national and cantonal bridge and road maps, technical audits, slope evaluation and bus stop assessments of Costa Rica
provider: Laboratorio Nacional de Materiales y Modelos Estructurales (LanammeUCR), Universidad de Costa Rica
